card.name: Disaster and evacuation news reports
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation inside news stories about hurricanes, blizzards, tsunamis and evacuations, such as 'down' after 'hunkered' or 'zone' after 'evacuation'. It responds to the running text of the disaster story, not one fixed word.
